- Harmoni Holdings Sdn. Bhd. holds 70.0% of shares  

**Overview:**  
Kirana Mutiara Farm Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company incorporated 15 July 2010, operating oil palm plantation and fresh fruit bunch supply in Labuan, Malaysia. It is owned primarily by Harmoni Holdings Sdn. Bhd., which holds 70.0% of shares; the remaining shares are held by other corporate shareholders. Financially, revenue grew from RM6.56 million in 2022 to RM7.28 million in 2024, with profit after tax ranging RM0.25–0.31 million and current ratio between 1.47 and 1.76. All audits are unqualified; three legal cases, none as defendant.
